verified_claims.claim: KM32 在 BioLector 中达到 215 mg/L taxadiene、43.65 mg/L T5α-ol 与 26.2 mg/L T5αAc，是酿酒酵母早期紫杉醇前体最高滴度
verified_claims.evidence: Abstract: "KM32 produced the highest reported yields of taxa-4(20),11-dien-5α-ol (T5α-ol) at 43.65 mg/L and taxa-4(20),11-dien-5-α-yl acetate (T5αAc) at 26.2 mg/L among early-step Taxol® metabolites in S. cerevisiae."；Conclusion (p.20): "we achieved 215 mg/L of taxadiene, 43.65 mg/L of T5α-ol and 26.2 mg/L of T5αAc titers that are the highest production yields reported until now in S. cerevisiae."

verified_claims.claim: KM32 相对于亲本 KM1，taxadiene yield 提高约 50%
verified_claims.evidence: Abstract: "KM32 achieved a 50% increase in taxadiene production, reaching 215 mg/L."

verified_claims.claim: 250 mL 反应器中 KM32 第 72 h 滴度 taxadiene 182.5 / T5α-ol 35.8 / T5αAc 19.2 mg/L，第 120 h 分别提升至 236.7 / 47.1 / 31.2 mg/L
verified_claims.evidence: p.19: "In 72 h, 182.5 mg/L of taxadiene, 35.8 mg/L of T5α-ol and 19.2 mg/L of T5αAc were produced. These reached to 236.7, 47.1 and 31.2 mg/L, respectively on the fifth day (Fig. 9B)."

verified_claims.claim: KMRJ31（OAR1Δ + DTR1Δ）取得最高 128 mg/L taxadiene；KMRJ19（DTR1Δ）产生全研究最高 221 mg/L GGOH，其次 KMRJ24 与 KM31 为 219 mg/L
verified_claims.evidence: p.16: "The combination of OAR1Δ and DTR1Δ in KMRJ31 resulted in the maximum taxadiene production of 128 mg/L"；p.17: "KMRJ19 with DTR1 deletion produced the highest GGOH with 221 mg/L among all the strains used in this study, it was followed by KMRJ24 and KM31in the galactose-containing medium with the 219 mg/L (p-value > 0.05)."

verified_claims.claim: Yeast GEM 8.5.0 含 4055 反应、2742 代谢物、1151 基因、14 个细胞区室
verified_claims.evidence: p.2: "yeast 8.5.0 comprises 4055 reactions, 2742 metabolites, and 1151 genes in 14 cellular compartments [28]."

verified_claims.claim: 敲除候选中 DPP1、OAR1、MDH3 显示约 40% 的 in silico 通量提升，其余敲除通量提升相对较低；过表达候选带来约 2 倍乙酰辅酶 A 通量提升
verified_claims.evidence: p.11: "the overproduction rates were relatively low in gene deletions except for DPP1, OAR1 and MDH3 that showed ~40% increase (Fig. 4)"；p.8: "clear increases were found with approximately two-fold overproduction in acetyl-CoA when particular genes were overexpressed in silico"

verified_claims.claim: Deep-well 板初筛中 KM21、KM25、KM13 相对 KM1 提高 taxadiene 35–40%；BioLector 复筛中 KM32 达 ~215 mg/L，约此前报道最高 137 mg/L 的 1.6 倍
verified_claims.evidence: p.16: "KM21, KM25 and KM13 strains increased taxadiene production by 35%–40% in the deep well-plates compared to KM1"；"~215 mg/L production was recorded with KM32. This is a remarkable improvement as approximately 1.6-fold higher production was achieved than the previously reported maximum, which was 137 mg/L in S. cerevisiae cell factories [23]."

verified_claims.claim: 17 个候选基因覆盖 9 敲除 + 8 过表达；KM32 由 ILV2、TRR1、ADE13、ECM31 四个额外过表达组成，分别涉及支链氨基酸合成、硫氧还蛋白系统、嘌呤从头合成、泛酸途径
verified_claims.evidence: Abstract: "17 genomic modifications, including nine gene deletions and eight gene overexpressions"；"The strain named KM32, which contained four overexpressed genes (ILV2, TRR1, ADE13, and ECM31) involved in branched-chain amino acid biosynthesis, the thioredoxin system, de novo purine synthesis, and the pantothenate pathway, respectively"；Table 1 列出全部 17 行。
